notes: A player puts reds in a pattern line whose wall row already has red.
rulebook: FACTORY OFFER (excerpt, paraphrased): You may not place tiles of a color in a pattern line whose corresponding wall row already has that color. Tiles you cannot or do not want to place go to the floor line.

expect.fact: You can't place a color in a pattern line if that row of your wall already has that color; the reds must go in another row or the floor line.
